skill_name: Explain the concept of evolutionary algorithms
workflow: Evolutionary algorithms are a set of optimization algorithms used to solve complex problems. These algorithms imitate the process of natural selection and can be used to optimize a wide range of real-world problems. They are inspired by the process of natural selection and work by starting with a population of possible solutions, or "candidates," and then creating a new generation of solutions by changing and combining existing solutions.
